Shelley and Heather will shop for food for [[Seed 2011]] and organize teams to help prepare three square meals a day starting with Friday evening supper February 4 and going through breakfast on February 7. Please contribute your ideas to the menu below! Remember this is a work in progress.

Does anyone have allergies? Anyone vegan?
